from azure.cognitiveservices.speech import SpeechConfig, SpeechSynthesizer, AudioDataStream

def synthesize_text(text: str) -> AudioDataStream:
    speech_key = "YOUR_AZURE_SPEECH_KEY"
    service_region = "YOUR_AZURE_SPEECH_REGION"

    speech_config = SpeechConfig(subscription=speech_key, region=service_region)
    synthesizer = SpeechSynthesizer(speech_config=speech_config)

    result = synthesizer.speak_text_async(text).get()
    return result

from azure.cognitiveservices.speech import SpeechConfig, SpeechSynthesizer, AudioDataStream

def synthesize_ssml(ssml: str) -> AudioDataStream:
    speech_key = "YOUR_AZURE_SPEECH_KEY"
    service_region = "YOUR_AZURE_SPEECH_REGION"

    speech_config = SpeechConfig(subscription=speech_key, region=service_region)
    synthesizer = SpeechSynthesizer(speech_config=speech_config)

    result = synthesizer.speak_ssml_async(ssml).get()
    return result

from azure.cognitiveservices.speech import SpeechConfig, SpeechSynthesizer

def select_voice(locale: str):
    speech_key = "YOUR_AZURE_SPEECH_KEY"
    service_region = "YOUR_AZURE_SPEECH_REGION"

    speech_config = SpeechConfig(subscription=speech_key, region=service_region)
    synthesizer = SpeechSynthesizer(speech_config=speech_config)

    voices = synthesizer.get_voices()
    for voice in voices.voices:
        if voice.locale == locale:
            return voice.short_name
    return None

from azure.cognitiveservices.speech import SpeechConfig, SpeechSynthesizer, AudioDataStream

def save_audio(audio_stream: AudioDataStream, file_path: str):
    with open(file_path, "wb") as audio_file:
        audio_file.write(audio_stream.read())

from azure.cognitiveservices.language.text.translation import TextTranslationClient
from msrest.authentication import CognitiveServicesCredentials

def translate_text(text: str, target_language: str) -> str:
    subscription_key = "YOUR_TRANSLATOR_KEY"
    endpoint = "https://api.cognitive.microsofttranslator.com/"
    client = TextTranslationClient(CognitiveServicesCredentials(subscription_key), endpoint)
    result = client.translate([text], target_language)[0]
    return result.translations[0].text

from azure.cognitiveservices.language.text.analytics import TextAnalyticsClient
from msrest.authentication import CognitiveServicesCredentials

def embed_text(text: str) -> str:
    subscription_key = "YOUR_TEXT_ANALYTICS_KEY"
    endpoint = "https://westus.api.cognitive.microsoft.com/"
    client = TextAnalyticsClient(endpoint, CognitiveServicesCredentials(subscription_key))
    result = client.text_analytics.entities(documents=[{"id": "1", "text": text}])
    return result[0].entities[0].name

from azure.cognitiveservices.speech import SpeechConfig, SpeechRecognizer

def transcribe_audio(file_path: str) -> str:
    speech_key = "YOUR_AZURE_SPEECH_KEY"
    service_region = "YOUR_AZURE_SPEECH_REGION"

    speech_config = SpeechConfig(subscription=speech_key, region=service_region)
    recognizer = SpeechRecognizer(speech_config=speech_config)

    result = recognizer.recognize_once_async().get()
    return result.text
